subject: Expansion request: onboarding two new product teams
messages:
From: Olivia Tan <olivia.tan@finovatehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Amanda Kim <amanda.kim@finovatehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Expansion request: onboarding two new product teams

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — the team was really impressed with the latency and cost profile on the dedicated pool. We're ready to expand, and I wanted to outline what we need and get your recommendation on timeline and costs.

Scope:
- Two additional product teams (Search Team & Insights Team).
- Each team will start with a single app integration, then expand to 3 apps over the next quarter.
- Expect ~1.2M tokens/month aggregate in Q1 of rollout, spiking to ~3.5M in Q2 after full app rollouts.

Questions/asks:
1) What is the simplest way to provision separate API keys for the two teams while keeping usage under the same account?
2) Can you provide a cost estimate (monthly) for the committed capacity we discussed plus an estimated marginal cost as usage scales?
3) Any SLA or capacity prerequisites we should be aware of for onboarding additional teams?
4) We may need minimal changes to retention settings for one of the apps — is that a supported request under our current agreement?

We'd like to start a pilot with the Search Team as early as February if possible. If you can send a short mutual action plan and any paperwork (SOW/order form), we can route it internally.

Appreciate it — cc'ing Amanda who will own internal coordination on our side.

Best,
Olivia
Olivia Tan
Head of Product Ops, Finovate Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Amanda Kim <amanda.kim@finovatehealth.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Expansion request: onboarding two new product teams

Hi Olivia — really glad the demo landed well. Short answer: yes, we can support team-scoped API keys, incremental capacity, and a pilot timeline for February. Below is a proposed mutual action plan and the items we'll need to kick off.

Proposed MAP (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): sign SOW/order form (I attached a draft).
- Week 1: Redwood provisions two scoped API keys + creates pilot routing into dedicated pool; we provide a testing quota and initial token cap.
- Weeks 2–4: Pilot (Search Team) — integration support from Rohan + CS check-ins from Evelyn.
- Month 2: Expand to Insights Team; provision additional keys and start gradual app onboarding (one app/week).
- Month 3: Review token consumption and decide on committed capacity uplift for Q2 (if usage meets threshold we discussed).

Cost estimates (ballpark based on your numbers):
- Committed baseline (to support spikes up to 1.5M tokens/month): $9,000/month (committed capacity + expected token burn).
- Marginal burst beyond committed: $0.0035 / token.
- If you commit to a quarterly uplift (3.5M sustained): we can offer a 12% volume rebate and reduced per-token marginal price.

Attachments: I attached a draft "Expansion_SOW_draft.pdf" and an "api_key_inventory_template.csv" you can use to track keys.

Next steps I suggest: you and Amanda review the SOW and pick two dates/times for an implementation kickoff this week. Rohan — can you confirm the network/SLA prerequisites and estimate lead time to provision two scoped API keys in dedicated? Connor — can you confirm whether we need any additional quota approvals for the Q2 spike? Evelyn — I’d like you to propose the CS check-in cadence.

Thanks — I can also jump on a 30m call to walk through the SOW.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Expansion request: onboarding two new product teams

Marissa / team — quick internal note based on Olivia's estimates:

- API key provisioning: we can create scoped API keys tied to the Finovate account with per-key rate limits and tags for team/apps. Lead time: same day provisioning once SOW is signed; I'll handle the tag policy.
- Capacity & routing: Pilot traffic (1.2M tokens/mo) fits into current dedicated pool with a small buffer. For a Q2 spike to 3.5M tokens/mo, we should either: (a) increase dedicated capacity by 1 additional GPU instance or (b) enable overflow routing to hosted pool with soft-fallback pricing. Option (a) gives the most consistent latency for their production apps; option (b) is faster to enable but may add latency variability.
- SLA prerequisites: need a signed order form for committed capacity and a network allowlist for the dedicated pool IPs. Also recommend a short retention exception request for the one app — security will approve with a documented use-case.

Action items from infra side:
1) Prepare a capacity plan doc for Connor to sign off (I'll draft).
2) Create two scoped API keys and the key naming convention in inventory template when SOW is signed.
3) Coordinate a maintenance window for routing changes (low risk).

I'll draft the capacity plan today and post it to the Drive link Marissa included.

— Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.com
